# Nika

> Semantic YAML workflow engine for AI tasks. Orchestrate LLMs, APIs, shell commands, and MCP tools with declarative DAG workflows.

Nika is a Rust CLI tool that executes `.nika.yaml` workflow files. Each workflow defines a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of tasks using 5 verbs: `infer` (LLM generation), `exec` (shell commands), `fetch` (HTTP requests), `invoke` (MCP tool calls), and `agent` (multi-turn autonomous loops).

Schema: `nika/workflow@0.12` | Extension: `.nika.yaml`

## Key Features

- **5 semantic verbs**: infer, exec, fetch, invoke, agent — each task uses exactly one
- **9 LLM providers**: Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, Gemini, xAI, native (local GGUF), mock
- **Provider fallback**: `provider: [groq, claude, openai]` — automatic retry on failure
- **30 builtin tools**: Media processing (nika:import, nika:thumbnail, nika:convert), introspection (nika:dag_info, nika:cost), and more
- **9 fetch extract modes**: markdown, article, text, selector, metadata, links, jsonpath, feed, llm_txt
- **Structured output**: 5-layer JSON schema enforcement with auto-repair
- **Vision/multimodal**: Send images to LLMs via CAS hashes (v0.34+)
- **Agent guardrails**: length, schema, regex, LLM judge — with retry/escalate/fail actions
- **31 pipe transforms**: String, array, numeric, type conversions — chainable in templates
- **Record & compression**: Task output recording with LLM-based compression (v0.51+)
- **Context budget**: Token-level control over task binding sizes (v0.51+)
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoints**: Connect to vLLM, Ollama, TGI, LiteLLM via named endpoints in nika.toml
- **12-level learning course**: `nika init --course` with 44 progressive exercises
- **115 showcase workflows**: Production-ready templates across domains

## Documentation

- [Full Reference](llms-full.txt): Complete consolidated reference — all syntax, verbs, fields, transforms, patterns, examples (~500 lines)
- [Syntax Reference](llms-syntax.txt): Workflow syntax — verbs, fields, bindings, transforms, providers, security, CLI commands

## Quick Example

```yaml
schema: nika/workflow@0.12
provider: claude
model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514

tasks:
  - id: research
    infer:
      prompt: "Research AI workflow engines"
      temperature: 0.7

  - id: summarize
    depends_on: [research]
    with: { data: $research }
    infer:
      prompt: "Summarize: {{with.data}}"
      max_tokens: 500
```

## CLI

```bash
nika run workflow.nika.yaml      # Execute
nika check workflow.nika.yaml    # Validate
nika ui                          # Terminal UI
nika init --course               # Learning course
nika doctor                      # System health
```
